visualReference.role: Component and material reference; not a game screen.

atlas.layout: 3 columns by 3 rows; crop with background-size 300% 300% and 0/50/100% positions.

generatedArt.prompt: Use case: reusable game UI asset atlas for an original street-ink multiplayer game interface study, informed by Splatoon 3's broad ink-and-sticker energy but not an official Nintendo asset. Square 3-by-3 sprite atlas with nine separate isolated graphic assets on a truly transparent background and generous gutters: irregular cyan ink splat, irregular electric-lime ink splat, coral-orange paint swipe, black-and-white halftone sticker burst, generic original high-top sneaker with neon laces, generic original angular swim-goggle mask with no face, blank torn-paper price sticker, blank diagonal caution-tape strip, small four-point victory badge. Punchy screenprint and cut-paper style, thick dark outlines, vivid flat spot colors, slight ink misregistration and halftone texture inside objects, energetic tilted silhouettes. No characters, no squid/tentacle shapes, no logos, no legible text, no background, no frame, no shadows between cells. All shapes fully contained; preserve alpha transparency.
